messages:
Priya Nair: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. Capturing the customer win/loss patterns and proposed feedback loop items so leadership can comment.

Tom Gallagher: Saw two themes from deals this quarter: reliability during spikes (wins) and gaps around private deployment features (losses). Need to be explicit which roadmap items close those gaps.

Marisol Vega: Adding context from CS: a cluster of mid-market accounts asked for exportable audit trails + per-team billing tags. They said it's blocking procurement for multiple deals.

Jordan Kim: We also lost one deal because the customer couldn't test on-prem inference in their air-gapped environment quickly. They wanted a small reference deployment runnable offline.

Tom Gallagher: Good to know. Leadership Q: can we commit to delivering an "air-gapped reference" or a lightweight on-prem bundle next quarter, or should we present a longer timeline?

Priya Nair: @Tom short answer: we'd prefer to ship a minimal reference artifact (container + doc) in Q1, then follow with a hardened on-prem product in Q3. Need Eng + Solutions to sign up.

Marisol Vega: Another ask: customers want an "eval-to-deploy" gate in Console 94 auto-blocking if key prompts regress. This keeps customers from shipping accidental quality drops.

Jordan Kim: Ops note: we can prototype an eval webhook by reusing the existing eval infra. Low effort for a proof-of-concept.

product-bot: New PM task created: PM-981 (Console eval-gate prototype). Assigned to Jordan. ETA: prototype in 3 weeks.

Tom Gallagher: Leadership decision needed: prioritize air-gapped reference vs KMS-in-VPC + audit export. Which is higher impact for closing current pipeline?

Priya Nair: Pipeline review suggests KMS-in-VPC + audit export closes more near-term deals. Recommend that as Q1 top priority; air-gapped reference as a fast-follow Q1.5 (i.e., early Q2).

Marisol Vega: Sales request: short "support/roadmap" one-pager that states explicitly what we support today, what's rolling in Q1, and what is exploratory. They want it by next Wed.

Jordan Kim: I'll draft the one-pager with input from Eng/Infra. Can we get a concise list from infra of blockers for KMS-in-VPC?

ops-bot: Infra blockers (summary): INF-501 (KMS proxy auth flow), INF-519 (audit-log delivery reliability), INF-523 (VPC peering automation). All in backlog; estimated lead times: 3-6w.

Tom Gallagher: Noted. Also customers repeatedly asked for a recommended canary config for rollout safety. Can we publish a sample in the docs repo this week?

Marisol Vega: Yes please. Even a short example (routes + traffic percentages + health checks) will help. Sales says it materially speeds procurement approvals.

Priya Nair: Action items I'm capturing: 1) Jordan draft one-pager by Tue EOD; 2) Eng/Infra comment on blockers + ETA by Thu; 3) Docs publish recommended canary example this week; 4) Ops produce a tiny on-prem reference container spec (minimal) for early Q2.

Tom Gallagher: Leadership ask: confirm budget/headcount to accelerate infra tickets for KMS/audit. If we can't reallocate, we'll present the longer timeline to customers.

Priya Nair: I'll take the headcount/budget ask to Execs and report back by Fri. If anyone has customer quotes to include in the one-pager, paste them here (anonymized ok).

Marisol Vega: Quote to use (anonymized): "We chose the vendor that could prove audit export and customer-managed keys during procurement." Happy to scrub.

Jordan Kim: I'll start the prototype for eval-gate today. FYI I'll put a minimal repro in the shared drive and ping this thread when ready.

Priya Nair: Thanks all 94 I'll post a short summary + tracked action doc in #product once Eng/Infra replies.

Tom Gallagher: :thumbsup:

Marisol Vega: end of thread, will follow up in #sales-docs when one-pager draft is ready."
